info.title: API.SH: HowLongToBeat
info.description: The HowLongToBeat API from API.SH: public HowLongToBeat data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A game's completion times in hours: main story, main + extras, completionist, all styles, co-op, multiplayer and any%/100% speedruns, each with average, median, fastest, slowest and number of polls; times per platform and platform group; DLCs and related games with their times; summary, developers, publishers, genres, platforms, release dates (world, NA, EU, JP), age ratings, Steam app id, review score with its distribution, player counts (completed, playing, backlogs, replays, retired) and user lists it appears in.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/howlongtobeat-game

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: current_players: also the people playing it now and recent backlog adds (one extra page read).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Game id (`68151`) or a howlongtobeat.com/game link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A game's completions tab: every player's logged time per play style (main story, main + extras, completionist, any% and 100% speedruns) with username, platform, play count, DLC flag, notes, video and score, plus speedrun videos. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/howlongtobeat-game-completions

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A game id or a howlongtobeat.com/game link.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Only one play style: main_story, main_extra, completionist, speedrun_any, speedrun_100.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: all (default), only (entries with notes) or none.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Only entries on this platform, e.g. PC.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Skip this many entries per play style.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Games with their completion times (main story, main + extras, completionist, all styles, co-op, multiplayer, in hours), number of polls, platforms, release year, review score and player counts. Every filter of the site's search: platform, perspective, flow, genre (include or exclude), release years, length range on a chosen time, DLC/mod modifiers, Game Pass, and its sorts. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/howlongtobeat-search

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Comma separated platform names as on the site (e.g. PC, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch).

parameters.name: perspective
parameters.description: Comma separated: First-Person, Isometric, Side, Text, Third-Person, Top-Down, Virtual Reality.

parameters.name: flow
parameters.description: Comma separated: Incremental, Massively Multiplayer, Multidirectional, On-Rails, Point-and-Click, Real-Time, Scrolling, Turn-Based.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Comma separated genres as on the site (e.g. Action, Role-Playing, Open World, Strategy/Tactical).

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Which time the hour range applies to (default main).

parameters.name: modifier
parameters.description: Hide or isolate DLC, mods, hacks.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
